Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 7944 of 2024
Petitioner :- Shanika Prasad Jaiswal

Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl, Chief Secy. Home Lko. And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Girish Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State and learned counsel for opposite party no. 4.
2.

By means of this writ petition, the petitioners have sought quashing of the First Information Report dated 25.07.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0165 of 2024, under Sections 420, 406, 506, 467,
468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Utraula, District Balrampur.
Petitioner also pray for quashing of entire criminal proceeding in the aforesaid case crime number.

3. On 24.10.2024, parties were directed to appear before the Senior Registrar for verification of compromise.

4. The report of the Senior Registrar of this Court dated 07.11.2024 is on record, according to which,
he has verified the compromise on 07.11.2024.
The original compromise is on record which has been annexed as Annexure-4 to the writ petition.

5. According to the terms of the compromise, parties have decided to withdraw all the cases filed by them against each other including F.I.R. dated 25.07.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0165 of 2024,
under Sections 420, 406, 506, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., Police Station Utraula, District Balrampur.

6. Intent is clear, the informant, who is a signatory to the compromise, does not want to press the FIR, therefore, no purpose would be served in allowing the proceedings even if charge sheet has been filed before the court below to go on considering the nature of the dispute.
7. Accordingly, the impugned FIR, which is the basis to serve consequential proceedings of investigation and thereafter filing of charge sheet, if any, is hereby quashed.
Consequently, all proceedings taken consequent to the lodging of the FIR including charge sheet, if any, filed before the court below stand quashed.
8. The writ petition is, accordingly, allowed.
9. The Senior Registrar of this Court shall communicate this order to the court concerned for correcting its record, accordingly.
10. Learned AGA shall communicate this order to the investigating officer.

(Om Prakash Shukla,J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 11.11.2024 Saurabh  Shanika Prasad Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl, Chief Secy. ... on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118233080/
